{{Otheruses|Whills}}
A '''Shaman of the Whills''' was a holy member of the [[Ancient Order of the Whills]], having knowledge of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].

==History==
[[Unidentified Shaman of the Whills|One such]] [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]] discovered a method to defy [[Death/Legends|death]] by retaining one's [[Force ghost/Legends|consciousness in the Force]] upon death, and shared this secret with [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]].<ref name="ROTS Jr">[[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith (junior novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' junior novelization]]</ref> Jinn then passed the knowledge on to [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], who in turn passed it on to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]],<ref name="Force spirit CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|287|Force spirit}}</ref> who would later use this knowledge to vanish while battling [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>

It was said to be accomplished only through compassion and love, thus the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] would never be capable of it.<ref name="ROTS Jr" />
